title: Life Sciences, Ecosystem and Engineering Governance Envelope
scope: Define auditable admission gates for biological, biomedical, biochemical, ecological, fauna, flora, ecosystem and engineering data before any operational or scientific claim.

limitations: No biomedical, clinical, ecological or engineering dataset is automatically approved by this architecture.
No ethics committee, biosafety, environmental licensing, professional responsibility or regulatory authorization is inferred.
Domain metrics and validation protocols remain TOKEN_VAZIO until a concrete study is declared.

data_governance.retention: Defined per study, ethics approval, legal basis, consent and source license; no indefinite personal-data retention by default.
data_governance.update_policy: Versioned per dataset, protocol, taxonomy, instrument calibration and study amendment.

security.secrets: No participant, patient, genomic, location-sensitive species or critical-infrastructure secret may enter CI logs.
security.incident_record: Contain access, preserve evidence, classify affected data, document notification duties and suspend affected processing.

metrics.definition: Required metadata fields present and non-ambiguous
Measurements carrying unit, uncertainty and calibration context
Analyses reproducible from declared dataset, code, environment and receipt
Applicable ethics, biosafety, environmental and engineering gates satisfied

acceptance_criteria: Study scope and population/ecosystem boundary are explicit
Applicable ethics, biosafety, privacy, environmental and engineering reviews are declared
Units, uncertainty, calibration, provenance and taxonomy are versioned
Claims remain bounded by study design and evidence
rejection_criteria: Sensitive data enters CI or public artifacts
Human or animal research lacks applicable review
Clinical diagnosis or treatment is inferred from an unvalidated model
Species, spatial scale, temporal scale, unit or uncertainty is absent
Engineering safety claim lacks declared design basis and verification
quality.change_control: DMAIC-compatible cycle: define, measure, analyze, improve and control, with immutable evidence and explicit exit criteria.

risks.description: Exposure or misuse of health, genetic, biometric or identifiable research data
risks.treatment: Prohibit by default; require case-specific governance before use

risks.description: Unvalidated model interpreted as diagnosis, treatment or public-health recommendation
risks.treatment: Explicit out-of-scope boundary and claim gate

risks.description: Ecological correlation promoted as causality across incompatible scales
risks.treatment: Declare scale, mechanism, confounders and validation design

risks.description: Research output used as safety-critical engineering authorization
risks.treatment: Require responsible professional, design standard and independent verification

rollback.trigger: Unauthorized data, ethics/privacy/biosafety breach, invalid taxonomy, calibration failure or unsupported safety/clinical claim.
rollback.procedure: Suspend processing, quarantine artifacts, revoke access, preserve custody record and revert public outputs where possible.
rollback.verification: Independent review confirms containment, corrected provenance and reauthorization before restart.

f_next: Select one non-personal public ecological dataset for a pilot
Define domain-specific schema and uncertainty model
Produce first reproducible receipt without clinical or operational claims
